nodes.label: AI Provider Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Redefined IAIProvider to take model/parameters per call. One implementation per vendor (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter) due to material wire-format differences.

nodes.label: Keyed DI Resolution
nodes.rationale: Uses .NET 8+ keyed services to select provider implementations at runtime based on ProviderKey, keeping Application layer decoupled from Infrastructure mechanics.
